proposals.before: Chang declined illness and did not attend court audience; after three years he died, posthumous title marquis Dao.
proposals.after: Chang pleaded illness and did not attend court audience; after three years he died, posthumous title marquis Dao.
proposals.reason: 謝病 means to excuse oneself on grounds of illness, not to decline illness.

decisions.reason: s0078 謝病不朝見 means Chang excused himself from court on grounds of illness; 'declined illness' misreads 謝病. The proposed 'pleaded illness' is accurate, grammatical, and matches the Chinese.
